transitions.authority: participant (R15): proposed grantee or authorized issuer in its scope
transitions.notes: Server-prepared from an exact proposal (§10.1: a caller cannot obtain approval for an arbitrary digest and later attach a different action); R15 fence: preparation trace and parent revisions. §10.1's state enum has no prepared state — 'prepared' is the folded pre-issue state of the §14.8 Mandate row, gap note G30. Stage-capable.

transitions.authority: participant (R15): proposed grantee or authorized issuer in its scope
transitions.notes: Child Mandate as a mechanical subset of every parent (§10.2): no new operation, resource, data class, destination, participant class, or manifestation; no later deadline or expiry; no larger budget, concurrency, use count, output size, disclosure, or retention ceiling; no greater delegation depth or fanout; no weaker security, evidence, review, or classification requirement; purpose restricted to the parent purpose and current Pledge lineage. Budget is reserved from the parent atomically; incomparable classification or policy domains block derivation; human non-delegable powers never appear in a child; a widening attempt fails authority_widening — gap note G33.

transitions.authority: participant (R16) or governance (R17): Participant for its exact prepared participant/resource-owner seat, or human principal for its exact prepared human-authority seat with a fresh challenge as required
transitions.notes: Seat Position record lifecycle under the §14.8 Position/Decision row, folded as a proposal-stage self-transition — gap note G19. Dual-surface operation: one schema pair, surface is a registry key — gap note G35.

transitions.authority: governance (R18): exact issuer/human-authority actor under decided rule
transitions.notes: §14.8: prepared/positions → active / issue. Locks the exact decision, the complete parent closure, and budgets; fresh challenge for root issue (R18); no bearer authority escapes commit; crash result: child delegated quantity conserved.

transitions.authority: governance (R18): exact issuer/human-authority actor under decided rule
transitions.notes: Successor issuance: when the prepared subject names a prior active revision, issuing the successor atomically supersedes it (§14.8 active → superseded / matching operation) — gap note G32.

transitions.authority: governance (R18): exact issuer/human-authority actor under decided rule
transitions.notes: A hold fences new uses. The catalog has no mandate un-hold operation and §14.8's Mandate row lists no held → nonterminal transition; none is derived (G25 precedent) — gap note G32.

transitions.authority: runtime (R34): trusted host effect service bound to exact prepared host Effect
transitions.notes: Consumption cascade of the ActIntent machine's owning consume: MandateUse ordinal slots are created on consumption (§14.8); the use consuming the last slot moves the Mandate to exhausted — gap note G32.

transitions.authority: governance (R18): exact issuer/human-authority actor under decided rule
transitions.notes: Revocation blocks new uses and cannot un-send prior effects; child delegated quantity stays conserved (§14.8); derived field names revoked_by_decision_ref/revocation_reason_ref — gap note G32.

transitions.authority: server: deterministic expiry at the record's expires_at (server time)
transitions.notes: §14.8: active → expired / matching operation; deadlines and expiry use authoritative server time (§10.5).
